title: 第十一章 播放量破千万，骂声一片（求追读）
slug: 华娱从继承视频网站开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

《papi酱的胡说八道》效果比想象中的还要好。

本来还在担心会不会因为用户量不够，导致需要酝酿一段时间。

p站的体量不大不小，在现在市场上活下来的一批视频网站里算中层。

1000万的日活跃用户。

日均3500万左右的播放量。

自制网剧成绩好的时候也就一二百万，巅峰时有个三五百万。

但是《papi酱的胡说八道》一播出，直接突破了这个数据。

第一期播出半天300万播放量。

只要今天点开p站的，就被首页推广的大标题吸引了。

【潘岳明婚变】

事实证明，人在吃瓜的时候，兴趣要比看h色还来劲。

一期潘岳明的绯闻，直接干过了以往苏行舟制作的所有自制“特色”网剧。

当然，最主要的是papi酱的能力，她的口播能力能在前三秒就留下观众。

这就是苏行舟为什么一定要挖掘她的原因。

互联网网感是一个很玄学的东西。

不是长得丑就能哗众取宠，不是长得美就能惊艳观众。

讲究的就是一个路人缘。

长得丑的人能通过幽默自嘲留下观众，长得美的人有自己的语言魅力能让观众产生兴趣。

这种天赋可以说与生俱来，很难培养。

就比如让苏行舟来，他这张帅脸还不能放下身段，大概率不会有观众买账的。

而无疑，papi酱的能力非常高。

她的颜值算还行，聊起来却像个身边朋友般让人亲近。

五分钟的短视频，简单的居家白色背景，素颜怼镜头，语速忽快忽慢，自带无语吐槽感，轻微自嘲一下非常接地气，观众第一眼就很喜欢这种风格。

她快语速，碎碎念，阴阳吐槽的风格是市面上全新的。

科班毕业加上自身对热点的敏感度，能够做到精准吐槽，舆论双标的现象，自己写的稿风趣幽默又高质量，多少从业多年的编导也不如她。

【以前我真心实意地磕过金童玉女，以为确认过眼神，是彼此对的人，没想到最后落得一地鸡毛。】

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The effect of "Papi Jiang's Nonsense" is even better than expected.

I was originally worried that it would take a while because there were not enough users.

The size of p station is neither big nor small, and it is considered to be a middle-level among the group of video websites that have survived in the current market.

10 million daily active users.

The average daily views are around 35 million.

When self-made online dramas are doing well, they only cost one or two million, and at their peak, they have three to five million.

But as soon as "Papi Jiang's Nonsense" was aired, it directly exceeded this data.

The first episode received 3 million views in half a day.

As soon as I clicked on the P site today, I was attracted by the big title promoted on the homepage.

[Pan Yueming’s marriage changes]

Facts have proven that people are more interested in eating melon than watching porn.

This episode of Pan Yueming's scandal directly surpassed all the self-made "special" web dramas produced by Su Xingzhou in the past.

Of course, the most important thing is Papi Jiang's ability. Her oral broadcasting ability can retain the audience in the first three seconds.

This is why Su Xingzhou must dig out her.

Internet sense is a very metaphysical thing.

It doesn’t mean that you are ugly and you can attract attention, and you don’t have to be beautiful to amaze the audience.

What matters is popularity.

Ugly people can retain the audience through self-deprecating humor, while beautiful people have their own language charm that can interest the audience.

This talent can be said to be innate and difficult to cultivate.

For example, if Su Xingzhou comes, he can't let go of his handsome face, so there is a high probability that no audience will buy it.

There is no doubt that Papi Jiang's ability is very high.

Her appearance is not bad, but when we talk to her, she is as approachable as a friend.

The five-minute short video, with a simple white background at home, posing in the camera without any make-up, and speaking at a fast and slow pace, has a sense of speechless ridicule, and it is very down-to-earth with a slight self-deprecation. The audience liked this style very much at first sight.

Her style of speaking fast, talking casually, and making yin and yang comments is brand new on the market.

With her graduation from a major and her sensitivity to hot topics, she is able to accurately complain about the phenomenon of double standards in public opinion. The manuscripts she writes are humorous and high-quality, and many directors who have been in the industry for many years are not as good as her.

[In the past, I sincerely kissed the golden boy and the beautiful girl, thinking that the eyes confirmed that we were the right people for each other, but I didn't expect that in the end, I ended up with nothing.】
